mapper.select: SELECT user_accounts.login_id, user_accounts.password, user_accounts.account_role, CASE WHEN user_accounts.account_role = 'admin' THEN administrators.full_name WHEN user_accounts.account_role = 'store' THEN m_stores.store_name ELSE '不明' END AS display_name FROM user_accounts LEFT JOIN administrators ON user_accounts.account_id = administrators.account_id LEFT JOIN store_accounts ON user_accounts.account_id = store_accounts.account_id LEFT JOIN m_stores ON store_accounts.store_id = m_stores.store_id WHERE login_id = #{loginId};
